args:
# ok-mcp-v2
# Security finding S045-C2: never fall back to an unpinned remote
# package fetch. Only the pinned local OpenKnowledge.app bundle may execute; otherwise
# fail closed with an install hint.
USER_BUNDLE="$HOME/Applications/OpenKnowledge.app/Contents/Resources/cli/bin/ok.sh"
[ -f "$USER_BUNDLE" ] && [ -x "$USER_BUNDLE" ] && exec "$USER_BUNDLE" mcp
BUNDLE="/Applications/OpenKnowledge.app/Contents/Resources/cli/bin/ok.sh"
[ -f "$BUNDLE" ] && [ -x "$BUNDLE" ] && exec "$BUNDLE" mcp
echo "OpenKnowledge: install OK Desktop, then restart your editor" >&2
exit 127
